role: integral of a Borel function against Lebesgue measure lambda^d on R^d, with x a bound variable of integration
notes: Durrett's notation case (a), sec. 1.4 p. 23. The bound letter is a dummy; with further arguments it selects the integrated section.

role: Lebesgue integral of a Borel function over the closed bounded interval [a,b], for real a <= b
notes: Durrett's notation case (b), sec. 1.4 p. 23. The limits name the interval and carry no orientation; an infinite limit is not covered by this case.

role: integral of a measurable function against a measure mu on (S,S), with y a bound variable of integration
notes: Durrett's notation in thm. 1.6.9, p. 32; same number as int_S f dmu. Same pattern as the kernel notation K(y,dx) of P15 regular-conditional-laws.

role: image measure B maps to P(h^{-1}(B)) of P under a measurable map h, a measure on the value space
notes: Durrett's remark after thm. 1.6.9, p. 32. Equal by definition to the law P_h of def:p15-pushforward-law; h^{-1} is the inverse-image map and does not presuppose invertibility.

role: Durrett's name for the Borel sigma-algebra of R^d (and of R when d = 1)
notes: Durrett p. 3. Quoted only when reporting his notation cases; the handbook writes B(R^d) (def:p15-borel-sets).

role: alternating step function on the half-line, its step values (-1)^n/(n+1), its partial sums and the limit of its interval integrals
notes: Local to this theorem and its proof; L lies between 1/2 and 5/6 although the half-line integral of g is undefined.

role: integrand cut off outside (0,1) and the law of the uniform identity variable U
notes: U_U follows the law notation P_X of def:p15-pushforward-law with the uniform measure U of thm:p15-lebesgue-unit-interval; its density is the indicator of (0,1).

role: pi-system of the empty set and finite half-open rectangles in R^d, a member rectangle, and the exhausting cubes (-n,n]^d
notes: Local to the annex proof of this lemma; same pattern as the pi-system P of thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-sigma-finite-uniqueness.

role: coefficients int g^2, 2 int fg, int f^2 of the nonnegative quadratic Q(theta) = int (f + theta g)^2, its real variable, its discriminant root D and its two roots
notes: Durrett's letters in the remark after thm. 1.5.2, p. 26 (a is the coefficient of theta^2). Local to this theorem and its annex proof.

role: infimum of the nonnegative function phi over the set A in Durrett's Chebyshev inequality
notes: Durrett thm. 1.6.4, p. 29; the same quantity is written c_A in thm:p15-expectation-bounds (registered row c_A of P15 integration-expectation). Used only when reporting the source.

role: identity function, mesh, partition points and cells of [a,b), lower and upper step functions, and the dyadic intervals [a2^{-k-1},a2^{-k})
notes: Local to the annex proofs of thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-affine-integral, thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-signed-density-values and thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-reciprocal-density.

role: uniform probability measure on the open unit interval and its sample space, with identity variable U
notes: Same meaning as the registered uniform space of thm:p15-lebesgue-unit-interval (P15 measure-extension); used in this chapter's corollary, examples and warnings.

role: integral against the Stieltjes measure mu_G of a Stieltjes measure function G, with x a bound variable; mu_G is the unique Borel measure with mu_G((a,b]) = G(b) - G(a)
notes: Durrett's notation case (c), sec. 1.4 p. 23. Extends the probability-only reading dG of def:p15-convolution-law (registered row of P15 convolution-gamma-normal) to any Stieltjes measure function; mu_G is mu_F of P15 measure-extension with F = G.

role: counting measure on all subsets of a set I, and the sum over a countable I read as the integral against it
notes: Durrett's notation case (d), sec. 1.4 p. 24. Scoped to this chapter; distinct from the Hessenberg sum # of P7 and the finite-size notation # of P17 social-choice.

role: an enumeration listing each element of a countable set once, and the Dirac measure at 0
notes: delta_0 is the Dirac law delta_c of def:p15-probability-density with c = 0; (i_k) is local to thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-counting-sums and its proof.

role: two functionals on nonnegative measurable functions compared by the four-step method, either of them, the set of measurable functions S to [0,infinity], and the point and Dirac probability used to borrow the simple approximation
notes: Local to thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-four-step, its annex proof and the second derivation in annex:p15-w02c-p15-001-change-of-variables.

role: real orders 0 < j < k of the compared absolute moments, and the conjugate Hoelder exponents p = k/j, q = k/(k-j) used in the proof
notes: j, k are Durrett's letters in exercise 1.6.11, p. 37. p, q are local to the annex proof; distinct from the Bernoulli parameter p of def:p15-w02c-p15-001-bernoulli.

role: parameter in [0,1] of the Bernoulli law, the event {X = 1} and the null event {X not in {0,1}}
notes: Durrett's letter p in example 1.6.12, p. 34. A and N are local to the annex proof of thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-bernoulli-moments.

role: the function 1/i on the positive integers, that index set, its dyadic blocks {2^m+1,...,2^{m+1}}, and the ratio 2^{-1/2} of a geometric series
notes: Local to thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-lower-moments-limits and its annex proof.

role: a convex function R to R, the expectation at which it is supported, the slope and the supporting affine function, Durrett's Figure 1.6 function x^2-3x+3, and the two masses of the rescaled two-point measure
notes: varphi as in def:p15-convex-integral and Durrett's Theorems 1.5.1 and 1.6.2 (pp. 25, 29); g is Durrett's letter in Figure 1.6 (p. 30). c, a, ell, m_1, m_3 are local to sec:p15-w02c-p15-001-jensen-hypotheses and its annex proofs.

role: the masses 3*4^{-n} on the positive integers I and 2^{-|m|-1} on the nonzero integers J, the sets {|f| > 1/n} and {f = 0}, the point of a one-point space, and a generic mass function with sum one
notes: Local to thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-jensen-infinite-mass, thm:p15-w02c-p15-001-jensen-integrability-limits and their annex proofs; p, q, I, r here are distinct from the same letters in sec:p15-w02c-p15-001-lower-moments.
